column1: # AGG WINDOW DEFINITION (#9009068.3) entries 1 "Personal Detail", 2 "Address" and 3 "Eligibility": the
# windows whose save RPC is AGG UPDATE PATIENT and that RpmsRpc::Registration.update files through.
# Extracted verbatim from FOIA-RPMS "Packages/IHS Patient Registration/Globals/9009068.3+AGG WINDOW
# DEFINITION.zwr" (OSEHRA ZGO export, 17-JUL-2019; FOIA update 2026-02-14), 2026-10-16. Only parameters
# listed in the window's "AC" index are kept: UPD^AGGPTUPD refuses any other name (AGGPTUPD.m:48-49).
# The same export's entry 28 matches the live read in new_patient_window.tsv (bcer-9.0-20260905-ydb)
# 0-node: file = piece 2 (UPD's FILE), secondary_file = piece 14 (SECFILE), save_rpc = piece 12
# (AGGPTUPD.m:22). Per parameter: name = node 0 piece 7 (the "AC" key), type = node 1 piece 1
# (X text, D date, C choice, T table/pointer, K check box, W word processing, N number, M multiple),
# field = node 3 piece 1 (a field of `file`), secondary_field = node 3 piece 7 (a field of
# `secondary_file`) (AGGPTUPD.m:62,74), filing_code Y = node 7 holds M that files it instead
